blocks.text: SaaS applications, such as SharePoint, might have dozens, hundreds, or even thousands of individual component sites. Instead of creating Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for each of them individually, you can create groups of sites that you want to share the same DLP policies.

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > SaaS Application Tenants > Manage Groups.
At the top right of the page, select an available application.
In the Add Group drawer, enter the following:
Name: The name of your group.
SaaS Application Tenant: Select one of your tenants. If you haven't added one yet, see Adding SaaS Application Tenants.
Sites: Choose to manually add or import sites. A group can contain a maximum of 10,000 sites.
Add Sites: Click the drop-down menu, select your desired sites from the list, and click Done.
Import Sites: Click Choose File and select a CSV file with your list of desired sites. A sample file is available to download by clicking Sample Import CSV File.
Comments (optional): Enter additional information regarding the group you are creating.

blocks.text: To learn more about setting up the DLP policies for groups, see About Data at Rest Scanning DLP and Configuring the Data at Rest Scanning DLP Policy.
In addition to creating groups, you can manage your groups and download lists of them as well.
On the Manage Groups tab, you can click the Edit or Delete icon to make any changes to an existing group. Click the Download icon to download a list of your sites in a CSV file.

On the Manage Components tab, you can view a list of all your sites, tenants, and site types based on the group they are associated with. Click the Download icon to download a list of your sites in a CSV file.
The site type is available only for those sites that are linked to a group.
